thought.text: Bagus, konteksnya jelas. Kamu sudah punya **3 sumber uncensored yang jalan**: obscurify, HEX, AllModels. Saya cek model uncensored di HEX dan AllModels — mungkin ada yang belum kamu pakai.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && echo "=== HEX: model uncensored/abliterated ==="; curl -s --max-time 30 -H "Authorization: Bearer hex_JXIdQEtRXvKClUStol_7JW9UPH-97uFFxkRDZ8a8aSs" "https://api.hexapi.io/v1/models" | python3 -c "
import sys,json
d=json.load(sys.stdin); ids=[m.get('id','') for m in d.get('data',[])]
print('total:',len(ids))
un=[i for i in ids if any(k in i.lower() for k in ['uncens','ablit','dolphin','hermes','venice','unfilter'])]
print('uncensored:',len(un)); [print('  ',i) for i in un]
" 2>&1 | head -20
